summary: The browser-tab icon, linked from web/index.html as an SVG favicon. It is a standalone copy of the brand mark shown in the sidebar and on the boot screen (a connector trace leading to a bright core dot), with its colours hard-coded because an image file can't read the app's CSS variables.

notes.text: The root `svg` element. The `xmlns` namespace is required because the browser loads the favicon as a standalone image rather than as markup inside the page; `viewBox="0 0 32 32"` defines a 32-unit drawing square that scales to any icon size, and `fill="none"` leaves shapes unfilled unless they set a fill.
The background tile: a 32 × 32 square with 8-unit rounded corners in near-black `#0B0C0E`, close to the app's `--bg`.

The connector outline, the same `M7 11h8l3 5-3 5H7` path as the `trace` path of the brand mark in index.html: from (7,11) it runs 8 units right, angles down to a point at (18,16), back to (15,21), then left to (7,21), forming an open tag shape that points right. It is stroked in muted grey, 2 units wide, with round caps and joins.
A horizontal line from (11,16) to the tag's point at (18,16), so the shape reads as something flowing to the right.
The `core` dot: a filled circle at (22.5,16) just past the point, and the icon's only bright colour: the aqua accent `#3EE6D1`, matching the brand mark inside the app.
